Normalization: Native IAM user Delegated owner-authorized controls are projected to the existing local caller only; no role or cross-account authorization is inferred.
Every response is native HTTP. Exact headers and bodies remain in evidence; generated request IDs, HostId and dates are not replayed.
SDK-representable requests use generated SDK inputs. Raw preserves missing required members and out-of-int32 days. An explicit empty expected-owner header is SDK-representable.
Native pagination tokens are bound at first response and reused rather than copied as local literals. Configuration order and page boundaries remain asserted.
Reopen marks settled configuration readbacks as a local persistence projection, not native restart evidence.
GET with empty id is represented through the SDK; native routes that query to LIST. Only its observed200 status is projected because the Get SDK decoder does not model the returned LIST body.
Recovery and final resource-absence observations remain evidence-only; no observed transient readback is projected.
Configuration quota fill is serialized in replay; native capture used eight concurrent requests for independent unique IDs.
